svg.aria-label: A request rail on a bench. At the front left, a browser with a screen and a keyboard sends a small carriage, the HTTP request, along a rail to a turntable, the router, which turns it onto the line for GET /api/orders; two other lines lead to /login and /api/users. The carriage waits at a barrier whose key reader checks the session cookie, then stops at the handler, a housing with gears, and at the cache, a box of key cards. On a miss it goes on to the ORM, which prints the SQL on a tape and sends it down a duct to a filing cabinet, the database, whose orders drawer slides open and is read. Then the carriage runs back and the screen shows the orders. A stopwatch at the front adds up the milliseconds, and a panel holds a session switch, an index switch and a cache flush button.
